item.title: [streams] Doesn't make sense to add `value` to `para.textContent` when `done` is `true`, i.e. `value` is guaranteed to be `undefined`
item.content:encoded:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/ReadableStream/getReader

Examples

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

I'm talking about the sample code under https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/ReadableStream/getReader#examples. For description see this issue's title.

What did you expect to see?

Don't look at value when done === true.

MDN, including comments in the sample code itself.
